prompt: What is the best project management software for remote teams?
jawaban:
1. **Asana** – [asana.com](https://asana.com) – Offers powerful task‑tracking, timeline views, and seamless integrations that keep distributed teams aligned.  
2. **Trello** – [trello.com](https://trello.com) – Uses intuitive Kanban boards and automation (Butler) to simplify visual project management for remote collaborators.  
3. **Monday.com** – [monday.com](https://monday.com) – Provides highly customizable workflows, real‑time dashboards, and built‑in communication tools for dispersed teams.  
4. **ClickUp** – [clickup.com](https://clickup.com) – Combines tasks, docs, goals, and time‑tracking in one platform, reducing the need for multiple apps.  
5. **Notion** – [notion.so](https://www.notion.so) – Merges project boards, wikis, and collaborative docs, giving remote teams a single knowledge hub.  
6. **Jira** – [atlassian.com/software/jira](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira) – Tailored for software development, it delivers agile boards, sprint planning, and robust reporting for remote dev teams.  
7. **Basecamp** – [basecamp.com](https://basecamp.com) – Offers a simple, all‑in‑one workspace with to‑do lists, message boards, and file sharing for remote teams that prefer minimal setup.  
8. **Wrike** – [wrike.com](https://www.wrike.com) – Features advanced Gantt charts, workload management, and real‑time collaboration for larger distributed projects.  
9. **Smartsheet** – [smartsheet.com](https://www.smartsheet.com) – Provides spreadsheet‑style project planning with automation and reporting, ideal for remote teams that love Excel‑like interfaces.  
10. **Teamwork** – [teamwork.com](https://www.teamwork.com) – Delivers comprehensive project, task, and client‑portal tools with time‑tracking and billing features for remote service teams.

prompt: Are there any enterprise-level project management solutions with strong security features?

8. **Adobe Workfront** – workfront.com (Adobe) – SOC 2, ISO 27001, SAML SSO, AES‑256 encryption, extensive permission matrices and audit trails.  
9. **Planview** – planview.com – SOC 2, ISO 27001, SSO (SAML/OIDC), encrypted data at rest/in transit and comprehensive activity logging.  
10. **ClickUp** – clickup.com – SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, SAML SSO, AES‑256 encryption, and fine‑grained user/role permissions.
